PATTERN: Session-end curation hook is a pure shell curl call to the memory server's curation endpoint. The server process (bun src/cli/index.ts) handles all Agent SDK, LLM calls, and complex logic.
WHY: Hooks can't use bun directly without causing fd leaks and zombie processes. Delegating to the already-running server sidesteps the problem entirely.
GOTCHA: If the server is not running, curation silently fails (curl to dead endpoint). The server must be up (launchd keeps it running).
FILE: settings.json → session_end hook → shell script → curl → server endpoint
